context: Asuka lectures on definitions and criteria.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; formal connectives (または/基準/いわゆる/同様/要素/ただし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い定義には、明確な基準が要ります。
lines.en: A good definition needs clear criteria.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 基準は、形または色で決めますか?
lines.en: Do we set criteria by form or color?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 形または機能、両方の要素を見ます。
lines.en: We look at both form or function as elements.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる例外は、どう扱いますか?
lines.en: How do we handle so-called exceptions?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ただし、例外も基準で説明できます。
lines.en: However, exceptions can be explained by criteria.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 音楽も、同様に分けられますか?
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、同様の要素で分類できます。
lines.en: Yes, it can be classified by the same elements.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いわゆる基本が、分かってきました。
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
